dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored perimeters surrounding dark centers. Notable features include a prominent closed 'O' structure in the mid-dorsal region and a cluster of interlocking 'C' shapes extending toward the posterior. Borders show high edge contrast with minimal transitional gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse density of solid high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters located primarily on the posterior dorsal-lateral region, distinct from the ring structures. These clusters show uniform intensity without internal dark nuclei.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular relationship exists between the centroids of the three largest central macro-annuli. The distance between the two uppermost annuli is shorter than the distance from either to the lower-most lateral ring structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, interconnected labyrinthine white patterning across the anterior-dorsal section, creating a dense network of non-linear geometries.
